hero.lead: I'm Alvin, a full-stack developer with a degree in Informatics Engineering from the University of Lampung. I'm interested in designing backend systems that are reliable, well-tested, and auditable, working with Node.js, TypeScript, React, Express.js, and PostgreSQL, and I have deployed to production on AWS and Google Cloud through automated CI/CD.
